name: HMAC Auth
description: Signs each request with an HMAC-SHA256 signature header. Compatible with many custom auth schemes.
author: zapi

config.label: Secret Key
config.description: The HMAC secret key used for signing.

config.label: Signature Header

config.label: Sign Content
config.description: What to include in the signed message.

config.label: Include Timestamp Header
config.description: Also send X-Timestamp with the Unix timestamp (seconds).
